Theme 001 · Product UI as the stage

Spreadsheet Cinema

The whole square is a live spreadsheet: formula bar on top, sheet tabs below, gridlines everywhere. The selection rectangle is the camera, the formula bar is the subtitle track, and Acme Pulse is a second, dashed teal selection that quietly scans every row while you work.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Formula bar — the subtitle track; every line of VO is a formula (=PULSE.FLAG(…)).
  • Name box — scene label (B2:G5 · PULSE · G4 · CTA).
  • Ink selection + fill handle — the human, and the camera.
  • Dashed teal selection — Acme Pulse scanning rows in the background.
  • Conditional-format tint + coral error triangle — the anomaly, with a cell note as the alert card.
  • Cell-pixel lettering / sheet tabs — logo drawn in filled cells; tabs show dashboard overload.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Marquee morph — the selection resizes/jumps between ranges, expo.inOut 0.35 s, always landing on a beat (every 2 beats at 120 BPM = 1 s).
  • Fill-handle cascade — values fill down row by row, stagger 0.015 s, total ≈ 1 beat (0.5 s) so a whole column resolves inside one kick.
  • Cell-pixel reveal — pixels light in a random-seeded order over 0.6 s; the last pixel (the coral dot) is quantised onto the drop at 0:08.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Why: every team already lives in sheets, so the stage reads instantly, and a second dashed selection is the most literal possible picture of “an agent working in the background next to you”. Risk: gridlines become noise at feed size, so frame 6–8 columns and keep the headline in a merged range.

Adapt to your product: put your own metrics or records in the rows and your product’s function name in the formula bar (=YOURAPP.CHECK()); the agent selection becomes whatever your product does automatically.
